items.text: Hello everyone,
We'd like to share some additional details about the upcoming Tadami Line release, which we know many of you are eager to experience as Train Sim World's first journey into Japan.

Our teams have made good progress ensuring that performance is at a level we’re happy with across the route, supporting both Gen-9 and PC platforms; however, we’d like to take additional time getting this Add-on ready for release and give you the best possible experience for launch.
We know this has been a long wait for many TSW fans, and the wait won’t be too much longer – in real terms, we’ll bring you more news about the release by the end of the month.
Thank you for your extended patience - this new, exciting journey is almost ready for you all to explore!

items.text: Hello everyone,

Today we have a minor update, including a selection of key improvements to texture and memory use on UK locos, including the Class 380, 802 and 220, as well as a few additional improvements for Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn, the Expert BR 145, and when using a raildriver control input.
This update will be going live from 10:00am BST, and please allow up to 24 hours for updates to arrive to your game platform.
Core
Fixed an issue where anti-jitter code stopped functioning on RailDriver causing inputs to be unstable. Fix re-applies previous functioning behaviour and restores stable inputs in most cases.
Please Note: Due to Raildriver hardware, it may not 100% resolve the issue but should now function as it did previously. In most of our test raildrivers it entirely eliminated the instability.
Optimisation & Performance
Additionally, we've targeted a few UK locos for art and texture optimisations to reduce the memory load and ideally remove instances of blurred textures. These changes affect:
Class 380
Class 802
Class 220 Voyager

items.text: Hello everyone,

We're pushing live our next core update today, bringing a range of improvements across core routes and locos, as well as additional improvements to Cardiff City Network, San Bernardino, Maintalbahn, Frankfurt Fulda, Thames Link Class 700 and Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn.

Performance has been a particular area of feedback that we’ve continued to work on for core routes, and we’ve made some optimisations to try and mitigate frame rate drops and deliver an overall smoother experience.

The Class 150 has had a large overhaul to its audio, including engine running sounds, safety systems, cab interaction audio, as well as doors and brakes. We’d greatly appreciate any further feedback from these changes.

From our previous announcements, we had planned a wider range of improvements for the recent Birmingham-Crewe route to align with this update; however, whilst these changes are still undergoing testing and quality assurance from our teams, we're taking more time to ensure they're ready to be released as you'd expect.

We apologise that we've not been able to deliver these improvements to the timeline we originally communicated, and we hope to have more news on when you can expect these in December. We're grateful for the feedback shared from the community, and we'll continue passing these notes to the development teams to support the route as best as possible when we're able to share the updates.
